後壁：菁寮老街與蘭花Houbi: Jingliao Old Street & Orchids

歡迎來到後壁，嘉南平原的稻米之鄉。菁寮老街的時間停住了：老理髮廳、鐘錶行、嫁妝店都還在。2004 年，紀錄片《無米樂》讓這裡的老稻農全國聞名。幾塊田之外，高科技溫室一次種出上百萬株蘭花。台灣是蘭花大國，而這裡就是它的首都。老街的米，高科技的花，一個後壁下午。

Welcome to Houbi, in the rice country of the Chianan Plain. On Jingliao Old Street, time stood still: old barbershops, clock shops and wedding-trousseau stores. In 2004, a documentary called Let It Be made its old rice farmers famous. A few fields away, high-tech greenhouses raise orchids by the million. Taiwan is an orchid superpower, and this is its capital. Old-street rice and high-tech flowers, one Houbi afternoon. Let's explore!

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

後壁是嘉南平原的稻米之鄉。菁寮老街保留著老理髮廳、鐘錶行和嫁妝店，紀錄片《無米樂》讓這裡的稻農全國聞名；幾塊田之外，高科技溫室則種出世界級的蝴蝶蘭。

Houbi is rice country on the Chianan Plain. Jingliao Old Street still has its old barbershop, clock shop and dowry shops, and nearby high-tech greenhouses grow world-class moth orchids.

  1. 2004紀錄片《無米樂》記錄菁寮稻農的一季。The documentary 'Let It Be' follows a season of Jingliao rice farmers.
  2. 每年春天 Every spring大約三月舉辦台灣國際蘭展。The Taiwan International Orchid Show is held here around March.

認識景點

About the place

老街：菁寮是周邊稻米村落的市街。 理髮廳：木造理髮廳保留了老旋轉椅。 鐘錶行：有一整面牆的擺鐘。 布行：農家到這裡買整疋的布。

old street: Jingliao is the market street of the surrounding rice villages. barbershop: The wooden barbershop kept its old swivel chairs. clock shop: The clock shop keeps a wall of pendulum clocks. cloth shop: Farm families came here to buy a bolt of cloth.

嫁妝：它的外號是「嫁妝一條街」。 柑仔店：還留著玻璃糖果罐。 穀倉：參觀老穀倉，再看看外面的稻田。 稻田：收割季節，整片地平線都變成金色。

wedding trousseau: Its nickname was Trousseau Street. general store: The general store still has its glass candy jars. rice barn: Visit the old rice barn, then look out at the paddies. rice paddy: In harvest season, the whole horizon turns gold.

紀錄片：2004 年的紀錄片《無米樂》記錄稻農的一季。 稻農：崑濱伯成了台灣稻農的代表人物。 蝴蝶蘭：台灣的蝴蝶蘭在世界花卉貿易中領先。 組織培養室：在組培室裡，冠軍蘭花被一盤一盤地複製。

documentary: The 2004 documentary Let It Be followed the farmers through a rice season. rice farmer: Uncle Kun-bin became the face of Taiwanese rice farming. moth orchid: Taiwan's moth orchids lead the world flower trade. tissue-culture lab: In the lab, champion plants are cloned by the tray.

幼苗：一次以十萬株計。 溫室：電腦調控溫室裡的光線、濕度和溫度。 低溫催花室：低溫室讓蘭花準時開花。 出口：盛開的蘭花出口到世界各地的買家手中。

seedling: Seedlings grow by the hundred thousand. greenhouse: Computers tune the light, humidity and temperature in the greenhouses. cold room: Cold rooms trick plants into blooming on schedule. export: The blooms are exported to buyers around the world.

蘭展：每年春天大約三月，台灣國際蘭展在這裡舉行。

orchid show: Every spring, around March, the Taiwan International Orchid Show is held here.

實景照片

Photos on site

溫室走道 Greenhouse aisle

蘭花溫室的走道，兩側是整排的蝴蝶蘭。

Rows of moth orchids fill a greenhouse in Houbi, home of the Taiwan Orchid Plantation.

淺粉色瀑布 Pale-pink cascade

淺粉色蝴蝶蘭沿著花梗一路垂下。

The flowers open one by one along the spike, so one plant can stay in bloom for months.

粉紅特寫 Pink close-up

大朵粉紅蝴蝶蘭的特寫。

Phalaenopsis means moth-like in Greek, because the wide, flat petals look like a moth in flight.

條紋粉紅 Striped pink

粉紅底、深桃紅條紋的蝴蝶蘭。

Dark pink lines run along the petals, so growers call this a striped moth orchid.

橘黃紅脈 Orange with red veins

橘黃色花瓣，帶細細的紅色脈紋。

Look closely: fine red veins run through the orange petals, and the lip in the middle is a deeper red.

紅色斑塊 Red blotches

紅色斑塊、邊緣帶白的蝴蝶蘭。

Big red blotches with white edges: this bold pattern is called harlequin, and it was first bred in Taiwan.

白色 White

白色蝴蝶蘭，唇瓣帶一點黃。

White moth orchids are a classic gift, and Taiwan, the world's top orchid exporter, ships them to Japan, the United States and Europe.

黃底酒紅斑點 Yellow with burgundy spots

黃底帶酒紅色斑點的蝴蝶蘭。

Each flower has three sepals, two petals and one lip; here the lip is the dark red part in the middle.

黃花與花苞 Yellow with buds

黃綠色蝴蝶蘭，花梗上還有許多花苞。

The thick, leathery leaves store water, and the green buds on the spike will open in the coming weeks.

白底桃紅斑塊 Magenta harlequin

白底、桃紅色斑塊的蝴蝶蘭。

A harlequin pattern of magenta blotches on white: no two flowers on the plant are exactly the same.

散步路線

Walking route

需開車或搭車 By car or bus在臺南市區外，需要開車或搭車前往。
It is outside central Tainan, so you will need a car, bus or taxi.
